If a prime ell divides both distance-three terms, the recurrence and the cyclotomic divisibility force ell in {3,7}. The mod-9 argument excludes 3^2 and the mod-49 calculation excludes 7^2. Complete recurrence periods modulo 3 and 7 then give the two residue conditions. A fresh independent replay through dozens of chain indices reproduced the exact formula, while the symbolic argument establishes all indices.
